comparison.allowed_differences: Only the two fixed mcycle reads and their subtraction may differ. Each trace must commit the difference between its two counter values at the subtraction.
comparison.value: the mcycle delta committed to x20 after a fixed 256-iteration warmup and a fixed 4096-iteration branch, call, and return interval
comparison.ras_ports: After the CPU trace matches, exercise two calls including a halfword-aligned return address, simultaneous pop and push, one return, one idle cycle and the last return. Verify that two pops drain the two-entry stack after three pushes. Compare addresses only when valid and leave the choice of entries retained on overflow ungraded.
comparison.cycle_observation: The RTL mcycle delta is recorded. The CPU trace and port comparisons determine functional success.

reconstruction.test_sources: copy the recorded directed test beside the pinned RISC-V Architectural Tests as performed by the evaluator
